script_text: Taurus, freeze right now: the stars are forcing a love reckoning and a career windfall on the exact same day. Monday through Wednesday, Sun in your 7th House squares Saturn, surfacing old partnership debts while Venus governs your demanding 6th House of daily service. But Thursday flips the script when Mercury stations retrograde in that same 7th House, demanding written confirmations before any relationship deal finalizes. By Saturday, your ruling planet Venus trines expansive Jupiter, turning casual networking into unexpected income within your financial sector. Wednesday is your power day because Venus enters your 10th House, elevating your public professional reputation instantly and fully. Thursday is your danger day because Mercury’s retrograde motion freezes every negotiation you started earlier in the week. Carry a notebook everywhere to record every verbal commitment until Saturday restores your grounded Earth element stability. Follow for your daily cosmic updates.
